messages:
lyla: Running into a Python SDK DX issue with async tool/function calling + structured output. Async path yields a JSON string or list-of-chunks for tool_result instead of a parsed dict/TypedDict.

noah: can you paste a repro?

lyla: Minimal repro:
```py
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(api_key='...')
resp = await client.chat.create(
    model='gpt-xyz',
    messages=[{"role":"user","content":"call fetch_user(7) and return JSON"}],
    tools=[{"name":"fetch_user","schema":{"id":int, "name":str}}],
)
# resp.choices[0].message.tool_result -> '"{\"id\":7,\"name\":\"Eve\"}"' OR ['{"id":', '7,', '"name": "Eve"}']
```

priya: sync client fine?

lyla: sync returns dict. Async seems to either double-encode or leave streaming chunks unjoined. SDK 0.9.3.

ci-bot: nightly job reported failures in py/test_tools_async.py::test_structured_output_streaming (RDW-531).

noah: likely in streaming adapter: need to buffer and json.loads when structured_output schema exists. Also add typing changes: annotate AsyncClient.chat.create return to reflect possible dict/str/list.

priya: short-term: add helper parse_tool_result(x) in SDK docs and update quickstart to prefer sync samples for function-calling until fix ships. That will reduce support noise.

noah: action items: 1) add failing async test and repro fixture, 2) implement buffer+parse in async reader when Content-Type is application/json or schema present, 3) expose helper + improve typing, 4) docs update and release note warning.

lyla: I'll attach logs and a minimal harness. Thanks.

docs-team: noted, will patch examples and add a snippet with TypedDict + cast to show safe handling.

ci-bot: ticket RDW-531 created, assigning to @noah. PR expected in 0.9.4 patch cycle.
